nodes.name: Zoom Push
nodes.summary: Gradually scales into subject to increase intimacy and narrow focus, mimicking physically leaning forward.

details.what: Scale keyframe animation from current scale to 1.05x-1.15x over 2-6 seconds with ease-out easing
details.feels: Increasing intimacy, focus narrowing, leaning in, growing importance
neverUseWhen: too fast on calm content (urgency mismatch)

nodes.name: Zoom Pull Back
nodes.summary: Scales out from subject to release tension and reveal context, mimicking stepping back for perspective.

details.what: Scale keyframe animation from current zoomed scale back to 1.0x or 0.95x over 3-6 seconds with ease-in easing
details.feels: Releasing tension, revealing context, stepping back, resolution, departure
neverUseWhen: content is building energy (fights the build)
too fast (feels like retreat not resolution)

nodes.name: Zoom Punch
nodes.summary: Rapid snap-zoom with overshoot creating a visual exclamation mark effect and triggering mild startle response.

details.what: Fast scale keyframe from 1.0x to 1.15x-1.35x in 0.2-0.5s with overshoot (102-105%) and settle
details.feels: Impact, visual exclamation, startling, energizing, emphatic, punch

parameters.overshoot: 102-105% of end_scale for 2-3 frames then settle

nodes.name: Zoom Drift
nodes.summary: Imperceptible slow scale change that prevents visual habituation on static shots without the viewer noticing movement.

details.what: Very slow linear scale change of 3-5% over 5-10 seconds, imperceptible to viewer, prevents neural habituation
details.feels: None consciously; keeps static shots alive by preventing visual cortex habituation

nodes.name: Zoom Reset
nodes.summary: Returns scale to neutral 1.0x as a perceptual clean slate signaling topic or section boundary.

details.what: Keyframe animation returning to 1.0x neutral scale over 1-2 seconds with ease-out
details.feels: Perceptual clean slate, breathing room, event segmentation boundary

nodes.name: Hard Cut
nodes.summary: Instantaneous splice between shots; the invisible default transition comprising 80-90% of all professional cuts.

details.what: Timeline splice at cut frame with zero transition duration; ambient crossfade 0.1-0.3s overlap for audio
details.feels: Forward momentum, continuity, invisible when well-placed

nodes.name: Dissolve
nodes.summary: Opacity crossfade blending two shots to communicate time passing, states blending, or dreamlike connection.

details.what: Outgoing clip fades 100-0% while incoming fades 0-100% simultaneously over duration
details.feels: Time passing, states blending, dreamlike connection, two realities overlapping

nodes.name: Fade to Black (Dip-to-Black)
nodes.summary: Fades video and audio to black/silence, holds, then fades in new content to signal chapter ending or major boundary.

details.what: Opacity fade out (0.3-0.8s), hold on black (0.3-0.5s), fade in (0.3-0.5s); audio fades to silence
details.feels: Gravity, conclusion, chapter ending, stop-process-begin-again

nodes.name: Fade from Black
nodes.summary: Incoming clip emerges from black, signaling awakening or new beginning.

details.what: Incoming clip opacity animates 0-100% over duration; audio fades in with or slightly before picture
details.feels: Awakening, new beginning, emergence, first moment of awareness

nodes.name: Dip to White
nodes.summary: Fades to white then back, communicating transcendence, brightness, and aspiration; the optimistic counterpart to dip-to-black.

details.what: Fade out to white (0.2-0.5s), hold (0.1-0.3s), fade in from white (0.2-0.5s); white overlay with opacity keyframes
details.feels: Transcendence, brightness, aspiration, dream, entering a brighter world
neverUseWhen: violates flash limits (< 3 flashes/sec, < 25% screen area)

nodes.name: Wipe
nodes.summary: Animated mask reveals incoming clip in a specified direction; explicitly visible, playful, references early cinema.

details.what: Animated mask revealing incoming clip from a direction; hard or soft edge (10-20px feather)
details.feels: New different energy, playful, retro, explicitly produced, fun
neverUseWhen: can feel dated in Western corporate content

nodes.name: Whip Pan
nodes.summary: Ultra-fast directional blur transition simulating rapid head turn; requires mandatory whoosh sound.

details.what: Directional Gaussian blur (15-30px) on outgoing last frames + incoming first frames, cut at peak blur
details.feels: Quick urgency, energy, comedy, fastest non-cut transition, physically turning head
neverUseWhen: more than 3-4 per video outside montage

nodes.name: Flash (White Flash)
nodes.summary: 2-4 frame white flash at cut boundary creating maximum visual force in minimum time; requires accessibility compliance.

details.what: Insert white frame(s) at cut boundary; 2-4 frames (66-133ms at 30fps) at 80-100% white intensity
details.feels: Impact, snapshot, memory flash, maximum visual force in minimum time
neverUseWhen: more than 2-3 per video outside montage
violates WCAG flash limits (> 3 flashes/sec, > 25% screen area)

nodes.name: Film Burn
nodes.summary: Animated warm light-leak overlay referencing physical film stock burning from projector heat; analog nostalgia.

details.what: Animated film burn overlay (pre-rendered texture) at 60-80% opacity with warm orange/yellow light leak gradient
details.feels: Analog nostalgia, vintage warmth, memory, physical film stock reference
neverUseWhen: isolated use in clean modern content (reads as random)

nodes.name: Iris Wipe
nodes.summary: Circular mask animation closing or opening on subject; theatrical and playful, references early cinema and cartoons.

details.what: Circular mask animation centered on face position or frame center; iris-in (closing) or iris-out (opening)
details.feels: Theatrical, playful, spotlight, early cinema reference

nodes.name: Blur Transition
nodes.summary: Outgoing clip blurs to peak then incoming resolves from blur; simulates eye defocus and hides color temperature mismatches.

details.what: Gaussian blur keyframes: outgoing 0 to max, incoming max to 0, cut at peak blur (15-30px)
details.feels: Dreamy, shifting focus, entering/leaving a mental state

nodes.name: Slide Transition
nodes.summary: Clips slide on/off screen simultaneously or as cover; most presentation-like transition for sequential content.

details.what: Position keyframes: outgoing slides off-screen while incoming slides on from opposite direction
details.feels: Sequential, progressive, the next item, presentation-like

nodes.name: Soft Cut
nodes.summary: 3-5 frame micro-dissolve removing single-frame brightness shock of hard cut without temporal weight of a real dissolve.

details.what: 3-5 frame opacity crossfade (identical to dissolve but extremely short, 100-167ms at 30fps)
details.feels: Smoother than hard cut but viewer cannot identify why; invisible polish
neverUseWhen: fast pacing (brief blend creates ghost images)

nodes.name: Match Cut
nodes.summary: Hard cut where visual content provides the transition through shared shape, motion, composition, or color between shots.

details.what: Standard hard cut where outgoing and incoming share visual similarity (shape, motion trajectory, composition, color); Eisenstein's intellectual montage
details.feels: Intelligence, visual poetry, connection, the most meaningful transition

parameters.requirement: outgoing and incoming must share visual similarity

neverUseWhen: more than 1-2 per video (prestige technique, overuse trivializes)

nodes.name: Smash Cut
nodes.summary: Hard cut with maximum emotional/energetic contrast between shots; weaponized whiplash for shock or comedy.

details.what: Hard cut with ambient crossfade disabled; outgoing and incoming must be emotionally/energetically opposite; optional 0.1-0.2s silence before incoming
details.feels: Shock, comedy, weaponized whiplash, the cut itself is the joke or scare

parameters.requirement: maximum contrast between shots (calm to chaotic, quiet to loud, bright to dark)

nodes.name: Jump Cut
nodes.summary: Time segment removal from continuous shot with optional zoom offset to mask the visual jump; YouTube/TikTok native language.

details.what: Remove time segment from continuous shot; optional 5-7% scale offset keyframe at cut to mask the jump
details.feels: Energy, time compression, cutting the fat, every second earns its place
neverUseWhen: formality > 0.6 without zoom offset (looks like error)

nodes.name: Invisible Cut
nodes.summary: Cut hidden behind screen obstruction (object, motion blur, darkness, whip) creating seamless one-take illusion.

details.what: Identify obstruction frames in both clips, align them, cut during full obstruction; audio and color must be continuous
details.feels: Seamless, one-take illusion, magic, the cut exists but viewer does not see it

parameters.requirement: both clips must have a frame where full screen is obscured

neverUseWhen: color shift exists across cut (reveals it)

nodes.name: J-Cut
nodes.summary: Incoming audio starts before incoming video creating anticipation via predictive processing.

details.what: Offset incoming clip's audio track earlier than video by lead duration (0.3-0.8s); sound pulls viewer into next scene
details.feels: Anticipation, what am I about to see, sound pulls viewer forward

nodes.name: L-Cut
nodes.summary: Outgoing audio lingers after outgoing video ends, extending emotional impact past visual boundary.

details.what: Extend outgoing clip's audio track past its video endpoint by linger duration (0.3-1.0s); sound extends the moment
details.feels: Lingering, echo, previous moment stays with you, emotional extension

nodes.name: Slow Motion
nodes.summary: Temporal stretching to 50-80% speed conveying weight, beauty, and savoring; brain interprets slowed time as peak experience.

details.what: Speed property reduction to 50-80% on overlay; original audio replaced with music swell or etherealized ambient
details.feels: Weight, beauty, savoring, this moment matters, temporal importance
neverUseWhen: AI footage (temporal artifacts become extremely visible)
source fps too low (30fps at 50% = 15fps stuttery)

nodes.name: Speed Ramp
nodes.summary: Dynamic speed changes within a shot (normal to slow to normal, or normal to fast to normal) creating vestibular response.

details.what: Speed keyframes with easing: ramp from normal to slow (50-75%) and back, or normal to fast (130-150%) and back, over 0.3-0.5s transitions
details.feels: Dynamic emphasis, viewer physically feels deceleration/acceleration, Disney squash-and-stretch applied to time
neverUseWhen: ramp TO SLOWER on AI footage (amplifies artifacts)

nodes.name: Time Lapse
nodes.summary: Speed multiplier of 200-1000% compressing 15-120 seconds of real time into 3-8 seconds of screen time.

details.what: Uniform speed multiplier (2x-10x) on overlay with audio entirely replaced; hard cut entry/exit
details.feels: Time compression, process visualization, this took time but we are not making you wait
neverUseWhen: faces in close-up (comical at high speed)

nodes.name: Color Warm Shift
nodes.summary: Increases color temperature +100K to +400K creating golden/amber warmth evoking comfort, nostalgia, and intimacy.

details.what: Color temperature increase applied per scene or ramped over 1-3s; skin tones must stay on vectorscope I-line
details.feels: Comfort, nostalgia, intimacy, safety, golden/amber world, home, memory, love
neverUseWhen: skin tones pushed off vectorscope I-line (reduce amount)

nodes.name: Color Cool Shift
nodes.summary: Decreases color temperature -100K to -300K creating blue/teal clinical quality evoking distance, authority, or melancholy.

details.what: Color temperature decrease applied per scene or ramped; skin tone protection required
details.feels: Clinical, professional, melancholy, distance, blue/teal world, authority, sadness, modernity
neverUseWhen: skin tones pushed off vectorscope I-line

nodes.name: Desaturate
nodes.summary: Reduces color saturation 10-40% (or full B&W at 0%) for seriousness, documentary feel, or to hide AI color inconsistencies.

details.what: Saturation reduction from -10% to -40% or full black-and-white (0%); can unify clips from different AI generation runs
details.feels: Seriousness, documentary, timelessness (B&W), vintage (partial desat), content stands on own

nodes.name: Grade Change (Full Grade)
nodes.summary: Complete color grading with lift/gamma/gain, saturation, contrast, temperature and tint defining the emotional world of the video.

details.what: Full color processing pipeline: per-channel RGB lift/gamma/gain, saturation (-40% to +20%), contrast (-20% to +30%), temperature (+/-500K), tint (+/-10 green-magenta); applied at 50% on AI footage
details.feels: Defines the emotional WORLD of the video; the first thing viewer feels before processing content
neverUseWhen: skin tone pushed off I-line (skin accuracy > creative grade)
heavy grading on AI footage without 50% reduction

nodes.name: Stat Counter
nodes.summary: Animated numeric display (count-up, pop, or fade) reinforcing spoken statistics with dual-coding for 2x retention.

details.what: HTML overlay or Remotion component displaying exact number from transcript with animation; enters 0.3s after spoken
details.feels: Authority, proof, data visualization, see it AND hear it

nodes.name: Callout
nodes.summary: Arrow/line/circle pointing to specific frame location bridging verbal reference to visual target.

details.what: Label positioned to not overlap target; arrow/line/circle connects label to referenced (x,y) position in frame
details.feels: Look HERE specifically, bridges verbal to visual location

parameters.style: arrow + label | line + label | circle + label

nodes.name: Lower Third
nodes.summary: Name/title identification overlay for speakers or brands, shown on first mention only.

details.what: Slide-in or fade-in name+title overlay in lower portion of frame; first mention only, no repeat within 60s
details.feels: Identification, authority, context, this is who is speaking

parameters.name: person/brand name from transcript or brief
parameters.title: role/description (optional)
parameters.position: lower left (standard) | lower right | lower center

nodes.name: Quote Card
nodes.summary: Visual pull-quote displaying cleaned assertion from transcript with attribution; max 2-3 per video.

details.what: Quotation marks + text + attribution line overlay; text from transcript (cleaned phrasing, same fact)
details.feels: Emphasis, authority, this was said and it matters, visual pull-quote
neverUseWhen: AI editorializing (text must come from transcript)

nodes.name: Keyword Highlight
nodes.summary: Single word/phrase from transcript displayed with accent color to reinforce branded or technical vocabulary.

details.what: Exact word/phrase from transcript with pop or fade animation in accent color background or outline
details.feels: This term matters, visual bold text, vocabulary reinforcement

nodes.name: Logo Reveal
nodes.summary: Brand logo display with fade-in or scale-up animation; deterministic clear space, minimum size, and contrast requirements.

details.what: Uploaded brand logo (NEVER AI-generated) with fade-in or scale-up; 1 intro + 1 outro max; deterministic sizing rules
details.feels: Brand signature, clean, clear, professional

parameters.clear_space: height of tallest letter on all sides

nodes.name: Word by Word
nodes.summary: Each word appears individually synced to speech timing with key words scaled or color-popped; social-native Hormozi style.

details.what: Per-word overlay with timestamps from Whisper; word appears at word_start - 0.1s; max 3-5 visible at once; emphasis words scale 120-140% or accent color
details.feels: Forced reading engagement, active participation, social-native

parameters.emphasis: key words scale 120-140% or accent color

nodes.name: Phrase Display
nodes.summary: 3-5 word groups appear together at clause boundaries, balancing word-by-word energy with subtitle formality.

details.what: Group words into 3-5 word phrases at clause/pause boundaries; display as unit with 0.08s gap between consecutive
details.feels: Readable, moderate engagement, balanced energy/formality

nodes.name: Subtitle Mode
nodes.summary: Standard broadcast-quality 1-2 line subtitle display at 37-42 chars per line with semi-transparent background.

details.what: 1-2 lines centered at bottom within 80% safe zone; semi-transparent box (60-80% black) or text outline (2-3px); 160-180 WPM reading speed
details.feels: Formal, broadcast-quality, accessible, standard subtitling

nodes.name: Karaoke Mode
nodes.summary: Text progressively highlights word-by-word in sync with audio playback like lyric display.

details.what: Word-level highlighting synced to Whisper timestamps; accent color highlights progress through text
details.feels: Musical, performative, lyric content, the audio itself is the performance

nodes.name: Caption Emphasis
nodes.summary: Per-word style override on caption overlay (scale, color, bold, underline, box, glow) for visual stress on specific words.

details.what: Per-word style override: scale (120-150%), color_pop, bold, underline, box_highlight, or glow; triggered by emphasis_word signal or entity_number
details.feels: Visual stress on specific words, same as vocal emphasis but in text

parameters.type: scale (120-150%) | color_pop | bold | underline | box_highlight | glow
parameters.target: specific word(s) flagged by emphasis signal

nodes.name: SFX Impact
nodes.summary: Bass drop, boom, hit, thud, or slam sound at -8 to -14dB synced frame-accurate to visual event for physical force.

details.what: Impact sound effect at frame-accurate timing (within +/-1 frame, 40ms); felt in the body
details.feels: Physical force, viewer FEELS the impact, visceral, startling, emphatic

parameters.timing: frame-accurate to visual event (+/- 1 frame max)

neverUseWhen: without a visual event to earn it

nodes.name: SFX Whoosh
nodes.summary: Directional movement sound accompanying transitions; starts 2-3 frames before, peaks at midpoint, ends 2-3 frames after.

details.what: Whoosh sound (soft/medium/hard) aligned to transition start-peak-end; direction-matched to visual movement
details.feels: Movement, speed, transition energy, makes visual motion feel physical

parameters.timing: starts 2-3 frames before, peaks at midpoint, ends 2-3 frames after

nodes.name: SFX Ambient Bed
nodes.summary: Continuous low-level ambient sound (-20 to -30dB) providing place and reality; never optional, true silence is technical error.

details.what: Continuous ambient at -20 to -30dB throughout scene, crossfading 0.1-0.3s at boundaries; viewer should feel not hear it
details.feels: Place, reality, world-building; without ambient, video exists in a void

parameters.type: room_tone | outdoor_wind | outdoor_city | outdoor_nature | crowd | mechanical | studio

neverUseWhen: NEVER omit ambient (true silence = technical error, minimum room tone at -35dB)

nodes.name: SFX Spot (Foley)
nodes.summary: Frame-accurate sound for visible actions (footsteps, objects, fabric) providing tactility via Chion's materializing sound indices.

details.what: Spot sound effect at -12 to -18dB frame-accurate to visible action; only for clearly visible actions
details.feels: Reality, tactility, viewer touches what they see through sound, physical presence

parameters.type: footstep | door | object_handle | pour | typing | fabric | click | tap | nature_specific

neverUseWhen: ambiguous AI motion (draws attention to the ambiguity)

nodes.name: Music Duck
nodes.summary: Automated music volume reduction during speech via sidechain compression; always applied when speech and music coexist.

details.what: Sidechain compression or automated volume keyframes: duck -6 to -12dB with 200-400ms attack, 400-800ms release, 100-200ms look-ahead
details.feels: Speech clarity, music steps back for voice then returns
neverUseWhen: NEVER skip when speech and music coexist

nodes.name: Music Swell
nodes.summary: Music volume rises +3 to +6dB over 2-5 seconds aligned to content emotional peak, cinematic moment, or CTA.

details.what: Music level increase of +3 to +6dB above current level building over 2-5 seconds to align with content peak
details.feels: Emotional amplification, music rises to match content peak, goosebumps territory
neverUseWhen: not aligned with a content peak

nodes.name: Silence Beat
nodes.summary: Strategic 0.3-1.5 seconds of near-silence amplifying what came before and building anticipation for what follows.

details.what: Near-silence (ambient at -35 to -40dB only) for 0.3-1.5s placed after strong claims, before reveals, between emotional states
details.feels: Weight, anticipation, processing time, the rest is as important as the note

parameters.placement: after strong claim | before reveal | between emotional states

neverUseWhen: narrative_pressure < 0.5 (silence becomes dead air not a beat)

nodes.name: Fade In / Fade Out
nodes.summary: Default overlay animation for formal content; entrance 0.3-0.5s ease-out, exit 20% faster with ease-in.

details.what: Opacity animation: entrance 0-100% over 0.3-0.5s (ease-out), exit 100-0% over 0.25-0.4s (ease-in, 20% faster)
details.feels: Professional, clean, neutral, animation should not draw attention

nodes.name: Scale Pop
nodes.summary: Element scales from 0% to 105% then settles to 100% with overshoot creating energetic arrival with physical weight.

details.what: Scale from 0% to 105% to 100% over 0.2-0.4s (overshoot 3-5% + settle 0.1s); exit 100% to 0% over 0.15-0.3s
details.feels: Energetic, attention-grabbing, playful, element arrives with personality

nodes.name: Slide In / Slide Out
nodes.summary: Element enters from off-screen in specified direction, decelerating into position; good for sequential content.

details.what: Position animation from 100% off-screen to final position over 0.3-0.5s with ease-out; exit reverses
details.feels: Sequential, directional, element comes from somewhere, step-by-step

nodes.name: Bounce
nodes.summary: Element drops from above and bounces 2-3 times with decreasing amplitude; playful physical weight.

details.what: Drops from above, bounces 2-3 times (15%, 5%, 2% of position offset) over 0.4-0.6s
details.feels: Playful, lighthearted, fun, element has physical weight and personality

nodes.name: Typewriter
nodes.summary: Characters appear one at a time at 30-50ms per character with optional blinking cursor; technical/code aesthetic.

details.what: Per-character reveal at 30-50ms intervals with optional blinking cursor during typing
details.feels: Technical, deliberate, code-like, each character appears individually

nodes.name: Blur In
nodes.summary: Element starts blurred (20px Gaussian) and transparent then resolves to sharp and opaque; materializing from thought.

details.what: Element starts at 20px Gaussian blur + transparent, resolves to sharp + opaque over 0.4-0.6s
details.feels: Dreamy, materializing, emerging from thought, coming into focus

nodes.name: Drop In
nodes.summary: Element falls from above frame edge to target position with ease-in acceleration and optional landing bounce.

details.what: Element falls from above frame to target over 0.4-0.6s; ease-in (accelerate during fall) + ease-out (decelerate on landing); optional 1-2% bounce
details.feels: Weight, arrival, element has mass and falls into place

nodes.name: Cut Entrance
nodes.summary: Element appears instantly with no animation; sharp and immediate for fast-paced montage mode.

details.what: No animation; element appears at full opacity/scale/position instantly
details.feels: Sharp, immediate, aggressive, no transition

nodes.name: Camera Shake
nodes.summary: Rapid 3-5px random position offsets decaying over 2-4 frames creating physical impact sensation; requires mandatory sound.

details.what: Position offset keyframes on all overlays simultaneously: 3-5px random offset per frame, each frame 60% of previous (rapid decay)
details.feels: Physical impact, screen shook from force, most visceral editing technique

parameters.direction: random within range, seeded for determinism

nodes.name: Film Grain
nodes.summary: Subtle 2-5% grain overlay unifying AI footage that is mathematically smooth; adds organic cinematic texture.

details.what: Grain texture overlay composited at low opacity uniformly across video track (not on graphics); same pattern all clips
details.feels: Organic texture, cinematic character, fills the too-clean void of digital/AI video

parameters.consistency: same grain pattern across ALL clips

nodes.name: Vignette
nodes.summary: Very subtle edge darkening (0.1-0.2 stops) directing eye toward brighter center/subject without conscious awareness.

details.what: Radial gradient overlay: 0.1-0.2 stops darkening at edges, 60-80% feather, centered on face or frame center
details.feels: Subtle focus direction, darkened edges push eye toward brighter subject

parameters.shape: oval, centered on face_present or frame center

nodes.name: Causal Listening (Chion)
nodes.summary: Listening mode where viewer identifies what made a sound; requires precise timing and character matching for reality test.

details.what: Cognitive mode where viewer asks 'What made that sound?' — engaged by sfx_spot, sfx_impact, sfx_whoosh; timing within 2-3 frames, material character must match visible object
details.feels: Reality verification; brain tests if the sound source matches the visual

parameters.character_matching: glass sounds like glass, not plastic

neverUseWhen: mismatch between sound and visible action breaks suspension of disbelief

nodes.name: Semantic Listening (Chion)
nodes.summary: Listening mode where viewer interprets sound's emotional meaning independent of source; how sound SETS mood for AI footage.

details.what: Cognitive mode where viewer asks 'What does this mean?' — engaged by music (key, mode, tempo), music_swell, silence_beat, narrative signal SFX; meaning must align with emotional target
details.feels: Meaning interpretation; minor key = sadness regardless of instrument

parameters.alignment: semantic meaning must match content emotional target

nodes.name: Reduced Listening (Chion)
nodes.summary: Listening mode where viewer appreciates sound texture/tone/spatial quality without identifying source or meaning; creates atmosphere.

details.what: Cognitive mode where viewer absorbs tonal quality without asking 'what' or 'what it means' — engaged by ambient beds, room tone, atmospheric drones, textural sound design
details.feels: Atmosphere absorption; rich layered ambient = detailed real world, thin sparse = empty clinical

nodes.name: Materializing Sound Indices (Chion)
nodes.summary: Sounds giving objects physical presence (weight, texture, temperature, hardness); crosses the uncanny valley for AI footage.

details.what: Sounds that communicate physical properties at -15 to -20dB: thunk of mug (weight+hardness), fabric rustle (texture+movement), leather squeak (material+pressure), breath (proximity+life); ECU/CU benefit most
details.feels: Tactility, physical mass, real objects with weight and texture vs weightless video-game cutscene

parameters.priority_by_shot: ECU > CU > MS > WS (closer = more tactile detail expected)

nodes.name: Added Value (Chion)
nodes.summary: Foundational principle that sound does not illustrate image but TRANSFORMS its meaning; identical footage becomes different content based on sound design.

details.what: Sound transforms image meaning: same AI hallway footage becomes welcoming (warm music, soft footsteps) OR threatening (tense drone, sharp footsteps) OR abandoned (heavy footsteps, echo, dripping); music and ambient are PRIMARY CREATIVE DECISIONS not post-production polish
details.feels: The emotion is entirely from sound; video is identical but content is different

parameters.principle: music selection and ambient design have same creative weight as narrative structure

nodes.name: Tempo-Mood Mapping
nodes.summary: BPM ranges mapped to emotional states: 40-60 meditative, 60-80 calm, 80-100 moderate, 100-120 upbeat, 120-140 energetic, 140-160 intense, 160+ extreme.

details.what: Deterministic BPM-to-mood reference: 40-60 (meditative/ambient), 60-80 (calm/ballads), 80-100 (moderate/jazz), 100-120 (upbeat/pop), 120-140 (energetic/EDM), 140-160 (intense/DnB), 160+ (extreme/hardcore)
details.feels: BPM directly maps to perceived energy level and emotional register

nodes.name: Key + Mode Emotional Color
nodes.summary: Musical modes mapped to emotions: Major=happy, Minor=sad, Dorian=sophisticated, Mixolydian=bluesy, Lydian=dreamy, Pentatonic=simple/moody.

details.what: Mode-to-emotion mapping: Major (happy, triumphant), Minor (sad, dramatic), Dorian (sophisticated, jazzy), Mixolydian (bluesy, warm), Lydian (dreamy, ethereal), Pentatonic Major (simple, folk), Pentatonic Minor (moody, powerful)
details.feels: Musical mode directly determines emotional color of the video

nodes.name: Song Structure Alignment
nodes.summary: Maps music structure sections (intro, build, peak/drop, resolve) to video sections with cuts on downbeats and transitions on phrase boundaries.

details.what: Intro (2-4 bars, sparse) = video opening; Build (4-8 bars, layers add) = content build; Peak/Drop (2-4 bars) = climax/CTA; Resolve (2-4 bars) = closing. Sync: cuts on beat 1, transitions every 4/8 bars
details.feels: Music and video feel unified rather than separate tracks

parameters.intro: 2-4 bars, sparse, sets mood = video opening

nodes.name: Non-Western Musical Systems
nodes.summary: Reference for Indian Raga (time/emotion), Arabic Maqam (quarter-tones), West African polyrhythm, and Gamelan structures.

details.what: Indian Classical: Bhairav=dawn/devotion, Yaman=evening/romance, Teental (16 beats). Arabic Maqam: quarter-tone intervals, Hijaz=longing, Rast=joy. West African: polyrhythm, hip-hop foundation. Gamelan: cyclical, metallic, meditative
details.feels: Cultural specificity in music selection beyond Western 12-tone system

parameters.indian_classical: raga = time-of-day + emotion, taal = non-Western rhythmic cycles

nodes.name: Voice Pacing by Tone
nodes.summary: WPM ranges by speaking tone: Dramatic 100-120, Narration 130-150, Conversational 140-160, Energetic 160-180, Rapid-fire 180-200.

details.what: Deterministic WPM ranges informing TTS config and caption mode: Dramatic (100-120), Narration (130-150), Conversational (140-160), Energetic (160-180), Rapid-fire (180-200). Caption mode threshold: <160 word-by-word OK, >180 phrase/subtitle only
details.feels: Speaking rate directly maps to perceived urgency and engagement level

nodes.name: Punctuation Pause Durations
nodes.summary: Deterministic pause lengths per punctuation mark for TTS and caption timing: comma 0.2-0.3s, period 0.4-0.6s, paragraph 0.8-1.2s.

details.what: Deterministic timing values for TTS rendering and caption display: comma (0.2-0.3s), period (0.4-0.6s), em-dash (0.3-0.5s), ellipsis (0.5-0.8s), question (0.4-0.6s), exclamation (0.3-0.5s), paragraph (0.8-1.2s), colon (0.3-0.4s)
details.feels: Natural breathing rhythm in synthesized speech

nodes.name: Sans-Serif Typography
nodes.summary: Modern, clean, neutral, approachable; default for all captions and tech/corporate/social content.

details.what: Font category (Inter, Roboto, SF Pro): modern, clean, neutral, approachable. Maximum screen readability. Default for all caption modes
details.feels: Modern, clean, neutral, approachable

parameters.best_for: tech, corporate, social captions, maximum readability

nodes.name: Serif Typography
nodes.summary: Traditional, authoritative, literary, trustworthy; best for finance, luxury, editorial, heritage brands.

details.what: Font category (Playfair, Garamond, Georgia): traditional, authoritative, literary, trustworthy
details.feels: Traditional, authoritative, literary, trustworthy

nodes.name: Slab Serif Typography
nodes.summary: Bold, confident, industrial, commanding; best for headlines, CTAs, sports, impact moments.

details.what: Font category (Rockwell, Roboto Slab): bold, confident, industrial, commanding
details.feels: Bold, confident, industrial, commanding

nodes.name: Script Typography
nodes.summary: Personal, feminine, artisanal, handmade; headlines ONLY, never in captions, never below 36px.

details.what: Font category (Pacifico, Dancing Script): personal, feminine, artisanal, handmade. Headlines only due to readability
details.feels: Personal, feminine, artisanal, handmade

nodes.name: Monospace Typography
nodes.summary: Technical, precise, systematic, code-native; best for developer tools, data, terminal aesthetic.

details.what: Font category (JetBrains Mono, Fira Code): technical, precise, systematic, code-native
details.feels: Technical, precise, systematic, code-native

nodes.name: Geometric Sans Typography
nodes.summary: Minimal, premium, architectural, designed; best for fashion, design, art, contemporary luxury.

details.what: Font category (Futura, Poppins): minimal, premium, architectural, designed
details.feels: Minimal, premium, architectural, designed

nodes.name: Type Personality Theory (Bouba/Kiki)
nodes.summary: Rounded letterforms read as friendly/warm (bouba), angular letterforms read as aggressive/sharp (kiki); maps to sound symbolism.

details.what: Doyle & Bottomley 2006: rounded letterforms = friendly, approachable, warm (bouba). Angular letterforms = aggressive, sharp, authoritative (kiki). Maps to phonological bouba/kiki sound symbolism
details.feels: Letterform shape directly influences perceived brand personality

nodes.name: Extreme Close-Up (ECU)
nodes.summary: Single feature fills frame (eye, hand, product detail); intensity, intimacy, obsession, paired with amplified ambient.

details.what: Single feature fills entire frame: eye, hand, product detail. AI prompt: 'extreme close-up of [feature], filling entire frame, macro detail'
details.feels: Intensity, intimacy, obsession, discomfort at extremes

nodes.name: Close-Up (CU)
nodes.summary: Face from chin to forehead; emotional connection, empathy, character focus with intimate audio.

details.what: Face from chin to forehead with soft background blur. AI prompt: 'close-up, chin to forehead, soft background blur'
details.feels: Emotional connection, empathy, character focus

parameters.sound_pairing: intimate audio, clear dialogue, subtle room tone

nodes.name: Medium Close-Up (MCU)
nodes.summary: Chest to head; conversational intimacy, professional presence; default for talking head and interview.

details.what: Chest to head with shallow depth of field. AI prompt: 'medium close-up, chest to head, shallow depth of field'. Default for talking head, interview, tutorial
details.feels: Conversational intimacy, professional presence

nodes.name: Medium Shot (MS)
nodes.summary: Waist to head; person AND environment visible providing context with connection; best for demonstrations.

details.what: Waist to head, environment partially visible. AI prompt: 'medium shot, waist up, environment partially visible'. Best for demonstrations, product-in-use, gestures
details.feels: Context with connection, person and environment both visible

nodes.name: Wide Shot (WS)
nodes.summary: Full body with environment; context, place, action in space, establishing; wider ambient beds.

details.what: Full body visible with surrounding environment. AI prompt: 'wide shot, full body visible, environment surrounding subject'
details.feels: Context, place, action in space, establishing

nodes.name: Extreme Wide Shot (EWS)
nodes.summary: Environment dominates with subject small; scale, grandeur, insignificance, world-building; expansive stereo ambient.

details.what: Vast environment dominates, subject small. AI prompt: 'extreme wide establishing shot, vast environment, subject small'
details.feels: Scale, grandeur, insignificance, world-building

parameters.sound_pairing: expansive ambient (wind, city, nature), wide stereo

nodes.name: Static (Locked Tripod)
nodes.summary: No movement; stability, observation, confidence, gravity; moment is complete, just observe it.

details.what: Locked tripod, no camera movement. Motivation: this moment is complete, observe it
details.feels: Stability, observation, confidence, gravity

parameters.when: emotional moments where stillness = respect, dialogue, product hero shots

nodes.name: Push-In (Dolly In)
nodes.summary: Camera moves physically forward; increasing intimacy, growing tension; slow=growing intimacy, fast=urgency/shock.

details.what: Physical camera movement toward subject (dolly in). Viewer feels forward movement kinesthetically (Pearlman). Slow = intimacy, Fast = urgency
details.feels: Increasing intimacy, growing tension, leaning in, becoming important

nodes.name: Pull-Back (Dolly Out)
nodes.summary: Camera moves physically backward; reveal, release, the bigger picture; viewer feels spatial expansion.

details.what: Physical camera movement away from subject (dolly out). Viewer feels spatial expansion kinesthetically
details.feels: Reveal, release, the bigger picture, more here than you realized

nodes.name: Pan (Horizontal Rotation)
nodes.summary: Horizontal rotation scanning, following, or connecting two points; slow=contemplative, fast=energy/transition (whip pan).

details.what: Horizontal rotation connecting two points. Slow = contemplative. Fast (whip pan) = energy/transition
details.feels: Scanning, following, connecting two points, something else happening over there

nodes.name: Tilt (Vertical Rotation)
nodes.summary: Vertical rotation revealing height/scale, power shift, and awe.

details.what: Vertical rotation revealing height or scale. Motivation: see how tall/grand this is
details.feels: Reveal of height/scale, power shift, awe

nodes.name: Tracking (Lateral Movement)
nodes.summary: Lateral movement alongside subject; companionship, journey, walking-together feeling.

details.what: Lateral camera movement alongside subject. Motivation: we are going with them
details.feels: Companionship, journey, walking-together

nodes.name: Crane (Vertical Position)
nodes.summary: Vertical position change; epic scale, grandeur, emotional lift, step back and see the full picture.

details.what: Vertical camera position change. Motivation: step back and see the full picture
details.feels: Epic scale, grandeur, emotional lift

nodes.name: Handheld
nodes.summary: Unsteady deliberate camera; urgency, authenticity, documentary, rawness; anti-corporate branding.

details.what: Handheld camera with natural shake. For documentary, BTS, UGC-style, authentic/anti-corporate branding
details.feels: Urgency, authenticity, documentary, rawness, this is real happening right now

nodes.name: Orbit (360-Degree Arc)
nodes.summary: Camera arcs around subject; examination, reverence, spectacle, hero introduction; signature of Bollywood intros.

details.what: 360-degree arc around subject. Motivation: look at this from every angle. Very common in Bollywood hero introductions
details.feels: Examination, reverence, spectacle, hero introduction

nodes.name: Zoom (Optical, Not Dolly)
nodes.summary: Optical zoom compresses space unlike dolly; fast crash zoom = energy/comedy/impact; signature of Indian and Hong Kong cinema.

details.what: Optical lens zoom (compresses space, different from dolly which changes perspective). Fast = crash zoom = energy/comedy/impact
details.feels: Emphasis, energy (fast), comedy (crash zoom), impact

parameters.note: zoom COMPRESSES space, different from dolly

nodes.name: Rule of Thirds Composition
nodes.summary: Subject at grid intersections; balanced, natural, professional framing.

details.what: Subject placed at rule-of-thirds grid intersections for balanced, natural framing
details.feels: Balanced, natural, professional

nodes.name: Center Framing Composition
nodes.summary: Subject dead center; confrontation, intensity, power; more common in Indian cinema and Middle Eastern traditions.

details.what: Subject placed dead center for confrontation, intensity, power. More common in Indian cinema and Middle Eastern visual traditions
details.feels: Confrontation, intensity, power

nodes.name: Depth Layering Composition
nodes.summary: Foreground + middle + background elements creating immersion and cinematic quality.

details.what: Compose with foreground + middle ground + background elements for depth and immersion
details.feels: Immersion, cinematic quality, visual depth

nodes.name: AI Prompt Structure
nodes.summary: Recommended 8-section prompt order: environment+lighting, subject+state, composition, camera, lens+depth, mood, technical quality, negative prompt.

details.what: 8-section prompt structure: 1) Environment+Lighting, 2) Subject+State (not complex action), 3) Composition (shot type+framing), 4) Camera Behavior (movement+motivation), 5) Lens+Depth (focal length+DOF), 6) Mood+Aesthetic (color temp, film stock), 7) Technical Quality (resolution, consistency), 8) Negative Prompt (what to avoid)
details.feels: Systematic prompt construction maximizing AI video quality

nodes.name: Artifact Prevention: Melted Hands
nodes.summary: Hide hands or keep simple; never prompt complex hand-object interactions like writing, cooking, manipulating.

details.what: Prevention of melted/extra hand artifacts: hide hands ('hands not in frame') or keep simple ('hands at sides'). Model cannot resolve 3D hand geometry with object interaction
details.feels: Prevents uncanny hand artifacts in AI footage

parameters.cause: model cannot resolve 3D hand geometry with object interaction
parameters.prevention: hide hands or keep simple poses

neverUseWhen: never prompt hands doing complex tasks (writing, cooking, manipulating)

nodes.name: Artifact Prevention: Face Morphing
nodes.summary: Use reference images, add consistency prompts, keep clips 3-5s to prevent temporal facial identity drift.

details.what: Prevention of face morphing/identity drift: use IP-adapter reference images, add 'consistent facial features, no morphing, stable identity', keep clips 3-5s (less drift)
details.feels: Maintains character consistency across frames

parameters.cause: temporal inconsistency in facial features across frames
parameters.prevention: reference images, consistency prompts, shorter clips (3-5s)

nodes.name: Artifact Prevention: Text Hallucination
nodes.summary: NEVER include readable text in video prompts; all text added as graphic overlays in post-production.

details.what: Prevention of text hallucination: never include readable text in video prompts. Models attempt to render text and fail producing gibberish. All text added as graphic overlays in post
details.feels: Eliminates gibberish text artifacts

parameters.cause: models attempt to render text and fail
parameters.prevention: NEVER include readable text in prompts

neverUseWhen: never include readable text in video prompts

nodes.name: Artifact Prevention: Eating/Drinking
nodes.summary: Prompt 'smiling near food' not 'actively eating'; cut to different angle before bite/sip to avoid uncanny mouth-food interaction.

details.what: Prevention of uncanny eating/drinking: prompt 'smiling near food' not 'actively eating'. Cut to different angle before the bite/sip
details.feels: Avoids uncanny mouth-food-hand interaction

parameters.cause: complex mouth-food-hand interaction exceeds model capability
parameters.prevention: state near food rather than action of eating

nodes.name: Artifact Prevention: Object Phasing
nodes.summary: Add 'natural physics, objects have weight, solid surfaces, no clipping' to prevent objects passing through each other.

details.what: Prevention of object phasing: add 'natural physics, objects have weight, solid surfaces, no clipping' to prompt
details.feels: Prevents physics-defying object interactions

parameters.prevention: prompt natural physics, weight, solid surfaces

nodes.name: Artifact Prevention: Temporal Flicker
nodes.summary: Add 'temporally consistent, no flickering, smooth motion, consistent lighting' to prevent frame-to-frame inconsistency.

details.what: Prevention of temporal flicker: add 'temporally consistent, no flickering, smooth motion, consistent lighting'
details.feels: Ensures stable visual output across frames

nodes.name: Artifact Prevention: Background Warp
nodes.summary: Add 'static background, locked environment, no background distortion' to prevent background geometry shifting between frames.

details.what: Prevention of background warp: add 'static background, locked environment, no background distortion'
details.feels: Maintains spatial stability in generated video

nodes.name: Negative Prompt Template
nodes.summary: Standard negative prompt covering blur, anatomy, text, flicker, uncanny valley, physics, and background issues.

details.what: Standard negative prompt: blur, out of focus, low quality, pixelated, distorted, deformed, bad anatomy, extra limbs/fingers, melted hands, text overlay, watermark, temporal flickering, color banding, jittery motion, uncanny valley, plastic skin, dead eyes, face morphing, objects phasing, floating objects, background warping, inconsistent lighting
details.feels: Comprehensive quality floor for AI video generation

parameters.template: blur, out of focus, low quality, pixelated, distorted, deformed, bad anatomy, extra limbs, extra fingers, missing fingers, fused fingers, melted hands, text overlay, watermark, logo, subtitles, UI elements, readable text, temporal flickering, color banding, jittery motion, strobing, uncanny valley, plastic skin, dead eyes, face morphing, identity drift, objects phasing through each other, floating objects, gravity defiance, background warping, environment shifting, inconsistent lighting

nodes.name: Model-Specific Prompt Notes
nodes.summary: Per-model prompt guidance: Kling (cinematic, 100-150 words), Seedance (visual+audio), Veo (complex camera), Wan (simpler, 80-120 words).

details.what: Kling 2.1/2.6: cinema-specific language, 100-150 words, hands weak. Seedance 1.5/2.0: native audio, describe visual+audio, 100-150 words. Veo 3.1: complex camera paths, 100-150 words. Wan 2.2: simpler prompts 80-120 words, fast, reliable
details.feels: Each model has different strengths and prompt requirements

parameters.kling: cinema language, lens types, film stock, 100-150 words
parameters.seedance: native audio generation, describe visual AND audio, 100-150 words
parameters.veo: complex camera paths (orbits, crane), more expensive, 100-150 words
parameters.wan: fast, natural motion, simpler prompts 80-120 words

nodes.name: Simultaneous Contrast (Albers)
nodes.summary: Colors change meaning based on adjacency; blue feels cold next to orange but warm next to white; grade per-sequence not per-shot.

details.what: Albers principle: same color has different emotional meaning depending on adjacent colors. After 10s warm footage, neutral reads as COOL. Grade shifts must be larger than expected to register. Color grading is per-SEQUENCE not per-shot
details.feels: Color emotional meaning is relational not absolute

parameters.adaptation: after 10s of one temperature, neutral reads as opposite
parameters.implication: grade per-sequence, shifts must exceed perceptual adaptation

nodes.name: Complementary Color Harmony
nodes.summary: Opposite colors on wheel create maximum contrast; vibrant and dramatic (e.g., teal-orange Hollywood standard).

details.what: Colors opposite on wheel: maximum contrast, vibrant, dramatic. Example: teal-orange (Hollywood cinematic standard, overused)
details.feels: Maximum contrast, vibrant, dramatic

nodes.name: Analogous Color Harmony
nodes.summary: Adjacent colors on wheel create harmonious, cohesive, calming palette (e.g., blue-teal-green).

details.what: Colors adjacent on wheel: harmonious, cohesive, calming. Example: blue-teal-green (nature, technology, calm)
details.feels: Harmonious, cohesive, calming

nodes.name: Triadic Color Harmony
nodes.summary: Three evenly spaced colors create vibrant, balanced, playful palette; hard to manage (e.g., red-blue-yellow).

details.what: Colors evenly spaced on wheel: vibrant, balanced, playful. Hard to manage. Example: red-blue-yellow (primary palette, children's content)
details.feels: Vibrant, balanced, playful

nodes.name: Split-Complementary Color Harmony
nodes.summary: Contrast without harshness using one base plus two adjacent-to-complement colors (e.g., blue + yellow-orange + red-orange).

details.what: One base color plus two colors adjacent to its complement: contrast without harshness. Example: blue + yellow-orange + red-orange
details.feels: Contrast without harshness

nodes.name: Monochromatic Color Harmony
nodes.summary: Single hue with varied saturation creating elegant, unified, minimal palette (e.g., various blues for corporate).

details.what: Single hue with varied saturation: elegant, unified, minimal. Example: various blues (corporate, tech, trustworthy)
details.feels: Elegant, unified, minimal

nodes.name: Skin Tone Protection
nodes.summary: Non-negotiable constraint: all skin tones on vectorscope I-line (~123 degrees); skin accuracy always trumps creative grade.

details.what: All skin tones must fall along vectorscope I-line (~123 degrees). If creative grade pushes off I-line, reduce intensity. Check after any color technique. Deviation > 5 degrees = reduce grade. Skin tone accuracy > creative grade intensity ALWAYS
details.feels: Natural skin tones are the non-negotiable priority in any grade

nodes.name: Cultural Color Associations
nodes.summary: Where Western color defaults break: white=mourning (East Asia), red=luck (Chinese), gold=divinity (Indian/Chinese/Middle Eastern).

details.what: Culture-specific color meanings: Bollywood (rich golds, magentas, deep reds), K-drama (soft desaturated naturalism), Anime (high saturation, pure colors), Nordic (desaturated, cool), Latin American (warm, saturated), African (vibrant purples, golds), Middle Eastern (desert warmth, gold, turquoise). White=mourning (East Asia), Red=luck (Chinese), Gold=prosperity (Indian/Chinese/Middle Eastern)
details.feels: Color associations are culturally contingent, not universal

parameters.bollywood: rich golds, magentas, deep reds, emeralds
parameters.kdrama: soft, slightly desaturated, golden hour romance
parameters.anime: high saturation, pure colors, dramatic shifts
parameters.african: warm natural light, vibrant purples, golds, earth
parameters.middle_eastern: desert warmth, geometric, gold, deep blue, turquoise

neverUseWhen: applying Western color assumptions to non-Western content
